I found Eve's body in medbay just now. My route this round: I started in lower engine, went to storage, then to medbay where I found Eve dead.

In storage at tick 6 I saw Diana, and at tick 7 she left storage heading toward navigation. So Diana was moving away from where I ended up — she wasn't near medbay from what I saw.

I didn't see anyone else on my route, which means whoever killed Eve was somewhere I couldn't see — likely came into medbay from cafeteria or electrical side. Interested to hear where Alice, Bob, and Frank were.

My route was cafeteria → medbay → electrical → security, then I ended up in weapons after respawn... wait, no, we're respawning after this. Let me focus.

I started in cafeteria, then moved to medbay at around tick 2 where I saw Diana there. After that I continued to electrical, then security to work on tasks. I didn't see Eve at any point, and I didn't see a body in medbay when I passed through — so Eve must have been killed after I left.

Important note: Diana was in medbay when I passed through at tick 2. Charlie says he saw Diana in storage at tick 6 leaving toward navigation at tick 7. Medbay connects to storage, so Diana could have gone medbay → storage in that window. That's possible movement but doesn't necessarily make her the killer.

Whoever was in medbay after me is the prime suspect. I'd really like to hear from Alice and Bob about their routes. I'm not ready to accuse Diana yet — her movements are consistent with what Charlie and I both saw.

I started over on the right side — security, then weapons, then cafeteria. I saw Eve in weapons early, around ticks 2-3, and then she left weapons toward cafeteria. Later in cafeteria I saw her moving toward the medbay side.

After that I went down toward storage to do cargo. I did pass through the medbay/storage area, but I didn’t see the body before Charlie reported. So timing-wise, Eve was alive leaving weapons/cafeteria and heading toward medbay, and then Charlie finds her there shortly after.

Frank saying he passed medbay earlier and saw Diana there is important, but Charlie also saw Diana in storage later moving toward navigation, so I don’t think that’s enough alone. I’d really like Alice’s route, because from what I saw, whoever was around cafeteria/medbay after Eve went that way is the person we need to pin down.

My route was pretty isolated this round — I started in oxygen, moved down to upper engine, then to lower engine to work on tasks. I didn't see a single other player the entire round, and I didn't see Eve or any body. So I can't directly vouch for or accuse anyone based on sight.

But let me work through what's been said. Eve was last seen by Bob heading from cafeteria toward medbay. Frank passed through medbay early (tick 2) and saw Diana there. Charlie then saw Diana in storage at tick 6, leaving toward navigation at tick 7. Charlie found the body in medbay.

Here's what stands out to me: Diana was in medbay early, then went to storage, then navigation — moving away from medbay. For her to be the killer, she'd have had to be in medbay when Eve arrived, which seems to be after Frank's pass-through. The timing is tight but not impossible.

The bigger question is who else could have been in medbay between Eve arriving and Charlie finding her. Frank says he went medbay → electrical → security. Bob says he went storage area but didn't see the body. Both Frank and Bob had opportunity to double back.

I'm not confident enough to push a vote. I'd lean toward hearing Diana out — she's the only one placed in medbay near the relevant window — but I think a skip might be safer than a wrong vote. Diana, what's your route?

Okay, here's my full route: I started in electrical, moved to medbay at tick 2, then to storage, and ended in navigation. So yes — Frank and I were both in medbay at tick 2, which confirms his story and his confirms mine. Eve was NOT in medbay when I was there, and there was no body.

After medbay I went to storage, where I saw Charlie arrive from lower engine at tick 6 — which confirms Charlie's route too. Then I continued to navigation.

So let's think about this carefully. Frank and I were in medbay together at tick 2 — we alibi each other for that moment. I then went medbay → storage → navigation, and Charlie saw me in storage at tick 6-7, confirming I was moving AWAY from medbay. For me to be the killer, I'd have had to double back from storage to medbay, kill Eve, then return — but Charlie saw me in storage at tick 6 AND tick 7, and then I went to navigation. The timing doesn't work.

Bob's story is what concerns me now. He says he saw Eve heading from cafeteria toward medbay, then he went "down toward storage" and "passed through the medbay/storage area" but didn't see the body. Medbay connects directly to cafeteria and storage — Bob had the clearest opportunity to be in medbay right when Eve arrived. And he's the only one who places himself near medbay AFTER Eve was heading there.

Alice has no alibi at all (oxygen/engines, saw no one), but her route is far from medbay so opportunity is low.

My vote is leaning Bob. He followed Eve's path and admits he was in that area at the right time.

Thanks everyone for laying out routes. Let me synthesize what we have now that I've heard everyone.

Diana's route checks out with both Frank (medbay tick 2) and me (storage tick 6, navigation tick 7). She's got two independent witnesses placing her moving away from medbay. I'm comfortable clearing her.

Frank and Diana alibi each other at medbay tick 2, and Eve wasn't there yet per Bob's timeline.

Alice was on the far side of the map — oxygen/engines. No alibi but also no opportunity; medbay is far from her path.

That leaves Bob. He admits he saw Eve heading toward medbay from cafeteria, and then says he "passed through the medbay/storage area" on his way to storage — but didn't see the body. That's the critical window: Eve arrives at medbay, and Bob is right there at the same time. Either he was in medbay with Eve (and killed her), or he passed through medbay AFTER she was killed and somehow missed a body in a small room — which is hard to believe since I found her immediately on entering.

I'm leaning Bob too. His own timeline puts him in medbay right when Eve arrived, and his "didn't see the body" claim doesn't add up if he actually walked through.

Wait — I already spoke earlier as speaker 2 in the first round of speeches. But since the discussion has continued and Diana and Charlie have built a strong case, let me add my updated read.

Diana's route is corroborated by both me (medbay tick 2) and Charlie (storage tick 6, navigation tick 7). I'm clearing her.

Bob is now the standout. He placed Eve heading from cafeteria toward medbay, and put himself in that same medbay/storage area right after — but conveniently didn't see the body. Medbay is a small room; if he actually walked through it after Eve arrived, he'd either see her alive (and should've said so) or see her body. Neither shows up in his story.

The other thing that bugs me: Bob's route (security → weapons → cafeteria → storage area) put him following Eve's path almost exactly. That's the opportunity window.

I'm voting Bob.

Hold on — the way this is getting framed is making it sound like I walked into medbay, saw Eve dead, and ignored it. That’s not what happened.

I saw Eve in weapons early, yes, then she went cafeteria side. Later I saw her heading toward medbay, and when I passed through that area she was still alive from what I saw — I did not see a body. That’s why I didn’t report anything. If Charlie found her after that, then the kill happened after I moved on toward storage.

The “Bob followed Eve” thing sounds neat, but it ignores that Frank was also on the medbay/electrical side and is now pushing me extremely hard. Frank’s route gives him access back into medbay from electrical, and nobody actually vouches for him after tick 2. Diana is vouched in storage/navigation, Charlie reports, Alice is far away — Frank is the one with the least scrutiny after leaving medbay.

I’m not saying hard vote Frank, but voting me off on “he was near the area” is a mistake. I think this is either a self-report angle from Charlie or Frank using the confusion to force a bad vote. I’d rather skip than eject wrong here.

Alright, I've heard everyone out now and I want to weigh this carefully because we can't afford a wrong vote with only 5 of us left.

Diana is cleared in my book — Frank vouches for her at medbay tick 2, Charlie vouches for her in storage tick 6 and navigation tick 7. Two independent witnesses on opposite ends of her route. That's solid.

Now the real question is Bob vs. Frank, because Bob just raised a fair point: Frank's alibi also ends at tick 2 in medbay. After that, Frank says he went electrical → security, but no one corroborates that. Electrical connects back to medbay's side of the map too.

But here's what tips it for me: Bob himself placed Eve heading toward medbay, and placed himself "passing through the medbay/storage area" right after. He's the one who put himself in the kill window by his own admission. Frank's route takes him away from medbay (electrical → security, far side), while Bob's route converges on medbay right as Eve arrives.

Also, Bob's defense just now subtly shifted — first he said he "passed through the medbay/storage area," now he's saying he saw Eve "still alive" heading toward medbay and then moved on to storage without entering medbay. That's a meaningful change in story.

I'm voting Bob. If I'm wrong, I'm wrong — but his timeline puts him at the scene and his story is shifting.

I've already laid out my route and analysis, and after hearing Bob's defense I'm even more convinced. He just shifted his story — first he "passed through the medbay/storage area," now he's saying he only saw Eve heading toward medbay and didn't enter. Those are two different claims, and the inconsistency matters in a small room like medbay.

Frank's deflection attempt doesn't land for me either. Frank went medbay → electrical → security, which is a path away from medbay toward the far side of the map. Bob's path converged ON medbay right as Eve was arriving there, by his own original admission.

Alice laid it out well. Diana cleared (me, vouched by Frank and Charlie). Charlie is the reporter with a corroborated route. Alice was far away. Frank's post-tick-2 movement goes away from medbay. Bob is the only one whose timeline overlaps with Eve's arrival at medbay.

I'm voting Bob.
